data.target: Original SSv2 action of the first eight observations; all later observations are distractors
data.readout: Frozen encoder; mean-pooled current tokens; separate ridge probe per condition, pooled across delays
data.feature_scaling: Center using training features only; no validation selection
data.scope: Controlled delayed-action diagnostic, not natural continuous-video or arbitrary-question recall
limits: Suffixes concatenate independent clips; delay is observations, not elapsed natural seconds
Original encoder was trained on eight-observation clips; longer inputs test length extrapolation
Task is known before observation; this does not test query-agnostic memory
A linear probe can underestimate information usable by other readouts
Validation is previously inspected SSv2 validation, not an untouched external test
Small probe split and one encoder seed cannot establish architectural superiority

checkpoint_info.checkpoint_selection: fixed optimizer step, not best selection

config.sampling: segmented history plus final observation; shared spatial crop; no flips

preprocessing: Deterministic original 8-observation sampling and SigLIP2 processor
representation: Mean of current 196x768 tokens; no past tokens/cache exposed to the probe
suffix_reset: Empty cache at evidence end, absolute observation index preserved
timing_scope: Concurrent main training allowed; no latency comparison
